extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) MS Word 2016 introduction — MS Word is a word processing application for typing, editing, and formatting text documents. Interface: Title bar (shows document name), Ribbon (toolbar with formatting tools), Text area (where you type), Cursor/insertion point (blinking line showing where text will appear), Status bar (shows page number, word count). (2) Formatting text — Bold (B button, makes text thicker), Italic (I button, makes text slanted), Underline (U button, draws line under text), Font size (number dropdown, makes text bigger/smaller), Font color (A with color line, changes text color). Formatting is selected first, then typed, or select existing text then apply formatting. (3) Saving and opening documents — Save: File > Save (or Ctrl+S or Save icon), choose folder, type file name, click Save. Save As: File > Save As, for saving with a new name or location. Open: File > Open (or Ctrl+O or Open icon), browse to folder, select file, click Open. Always save before closing to avoid losing work. Misconceptions: 'closing a document saves it automatically' (you must save before closing or your work is lost), 'Bold and Italic are the same' (Bold makes text thicker, Italic makes it slanted), 'font size and font color are the same' (size changes how big text is, color changes its color), 'you can only type at the end' (you can click anywhere to move the cursor and type there), 'Save and Save As are the same' (Save overwrites the existing file, Save As creates a new copy with a different name or location). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function WindowsWordGame), NOT export default. Export interface WindowsWordGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
